highlights.description: Initial release: a Go SDK for the Postman API covering all 31 service areas (196 endpoints) through a single `*postman.Client`

Postman publishes no downloadable OpenAPI document, so `scripts/gen-openapi` reconstructs one from Postman's official TypeScript SDK via a reusable ts-morph generator, keeping the grokify SDK pipeline consistent across providers
Full MkDocs documentation site (installation, auth, errors, rate limiting, and a usage page per service) plus a Scalar-rendered API reference generated from the OpenAPI spec

added.description: TypeScript-SDK-to-OpenAPI spec generator (`scripts/gen-openapi`) and the reconstructed OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (`openapi/openapi.yaml`) covering all 31 service areas / 196 endpoints
ogen-generated internal API client (`internal/api`) covering all 196 endpoints, generated via ogen v1.24.0
Shared `postmanerr` package: `APIError`, `FromProblemDetails` (RFC 9457 problem-details mapping), and `Empty` (for TS union error schemas that collapse to no recoverable body detail)

Secret Scanner service wrapper (`secretscanner`) — the first hand-written service package, establishing the pattern (plain Go input/result types, string-const enums, `postmanerr`-based error mapping) every other service follows
Collections, Specs, and Workspaces service wrappers
Mocks, Collection Items, Teams, and SDK Generation service wrappers
Environments, Components, Monitors, Private API Network, and Tags service wrappers
Collection comment (folders/requests/responses) and Users service wrappers
Pull Requests, OAuth 2.0, Groups, and Collection Access Keys service wrappers
Billing, Audit Logs, Analytics, Webhooks, and Service Accounts service wrappers
Search, Postbot, Import, Comments, and API Security service wrappers

Top-level `postman.Client` wiring all 31 services, with one accessor per service (`Collections()`, `Workspaces()`, `SecretScanner()`, ...), shared auth/HTTP configuration, and `API()`/`BaseURL()` escape hatches

fixed.description: gosec G101 false positives on `EnvAPIKey`, `SecretTypeOriginTeamRegex`, and `MetricCreditUsageByModel` — the identifier names matched gosec's credential heuristic even though the values are an environment variable name and public enum tags, not secrets

dupl false positives on sibling wrapper methods that each switch over a distinct ogen-generated response/error type (`collectionitems`, `sdkgen`, `specs`, `tags`) — no common interface exists to extract a shared helper over without reflection or per-type adapters

`collectionitems.CreateResponseInput`/`UpdateResponseInput` embedded an unexported `responseFields` struct, silently breaking composite-literal construction (`&Input{Field: value}`) — the one construction idiom used everywhere else in the SDK. Found while writing and compiling the collection items documentation examples against the real module

tests.description: Suppressed dupl false positives on standalone per-endpoint tests that intentionally don't consolidate into table-driven tests, to preserve per-test clarity

documentation.description: README, runnable example program, and design notes
Documented the Scalar API reference page in the README
Added CI/lint/docs status shields to the README
MkDocs + Material site scaffold: home page, installation, quick start, and three cross-cutting guides (authentication, error handling, rate limiting) that sit above the per-service pages in nav
Per-service usage pages for all 31 services, each covering every exported method with code examples verified against the actual Go source
Linked the MkDocs site from the README
